title: Experiments: weather, soil and years of the experiment
intro: The weather list of an experiment follows the choice at the top of the tab and offers the built-in stations as well. The soil, the years and what is saved are set beside it.

marks.d: Online weather of my area, the weather of the SWAFL project, my weather, or a built-in station.
The place whose weather is read from the internet.

The soil of the experiment when it is not a factor.
First and last year of every run.
